column2: ...There might be another device like this somewhere. Let's find it.
We gotta find it before the Demon King catches {p}.
We'll rescue Mazinger Z.\n\nShusha, you go find {p}!
We'll rescue Getter Robo.\n\nShusha, you go find {p}!
No reaction at all...
...Hm? What's this...!?
I see... We were drawn in by this sun relief...
Seems that way. Though I've no idea how the mechanism works.
Maybe we can rescue {s} through the moon relief...
The moon's shining... A black moon!?
Look out, {p}! Get out of the light!!
The moon's shining... A black moon!?
No good, it won't react anymore.
A different fate... huh.
This school's done for. There's no one left inside. You should run too!!
I'm sure Natsu-chan ran into the forest too. Let's look for her!
The fire's too strong. We can't get inside.
Everyone, thanks for everything!

{p}, I've made up my mind! Someday I'm gonna make Kanto a place where people can live in peace and safety. A place where grown-ups and kids alike can live together as friends! Together with my friends at the Quake Fort!!
Back in your world, the harshest of fates may be awaiting you...
No problem! Not as long as I've got my friends!
Bring it on, I say!\n\nA boring world? I'll pass, thanks!
Ahahaha... Oh, Mondo!
Whatever world it is, you guys will do just fine!
No way!?
Phew... Thank goodness...
Oh no! {s}'s waiting!
You're late, {p}! You're never on time!
W-well, um... the thing is... would she even understand if I explained...?
No excuses! I'm through with you!
...Hey, what's that?
A black moon!? Don't tell me it's that again!?
...What are you talking about?\n\nLook! The moon's getting bigger!
Uhh... nnn... Wh-where am I...? Ugh... My head hurts... Like it's splitting...
Are you okay? Hang in there!
...What happened to us?
The black moon... appeared...!
I-I remember now...!!
There's someone collapsed over there...!
Huh? But we were the only ones in the park!
Y-yeah... Ugh... My head... it hurts... Ugh... I feel like I'm forgetting something important... I don't know...
Are you okay, {p}?
...I'm okay. Anyway, we should go check...
Hey! Are you okay!?
...I'm fine.
Wh-who are you...?
Hey, what are you staring at!? Look, there's somebody collapsed over there too!
Hey! Are you okay!?
He seems kind of a pushover...
Sorry...
You heard that? I'm sorry...
It's fine. Did you guys help me?
I guess... that counts as helping?
We don't know what's going on either.
I see. I'm Akira Fudo. And you guys are...?
I'm Honey Kisaragi.
I'm {p}...\n\nBut I feel like I've met you two somewhere before...
Have you?
...I think this is the first time we've met.
Hmmm, what is this feeling... Is it that deja vu thing?
I'm {s}. Nice to meet you!
...So, Akira-kun, you were on your way home from school.
I was heading back to the Makimuras', where I board. Miki-chan must be worried...
Is Miki-chan your girlfriend? Lucky you. Me, I'm at an all-girls boarding school.
No boyfriend?
It's nothing but girls around me...
Where were you, Honey?
I was meeting my roommate.
If I miss curfew, I can't get back into the dorm. So...
The two of you were going to sneak back into the dorm?
Uh-huh.
Oh, excuse me a second.
...I bet that's from a friend.
Huh? Oh, hello...
...I bet that's from your father.
Huh? Oh, hello...
It cut off... I wonder if something happened...? But anyway... how did you know it was Papa?
That's right! The call for me too!
I-I don't know...
You said something like you'd met us before...?
There's something strange about you.
Then I'm going with Honey! If I let you go with a girl this cute... it'd be dangerous!
Wh-wh-what's that supposed to mean, {s}?
Hmph! There, teams all set! I'm going with Honey, and {p}'s going with Akira-kun!
This place is apparently called the "Hill of Beginnings." Once we've each done what we came for, we all meet back at the "Hill of Beginnings"!
Well then, let's go, Honey!
Well then, everyone, see you later!
{p}-kun, shall we go too?
...Anyway, one thing's clear: I have to take the right path, where Papa's calling me, and Akira-kun has to take the left path, like Ryo-kun said.
At this rate, we can't get back to the Hill of Beginnings...
Let's go as far as we can.
No way the car'll make it. Oh well, let's walk!
...This is no good...
There's a road over here. Shall we try it?
Yeah!
Hey, hey! Didn't we come down this road a minute ago?
You too? I had that feeling as well...
Phew... What on earth is going on?
Halt!
